children: Overview
UK biopharma firm's H1 loss widened, driven by non-cash share-based payment charge
Company raised £5.6 mln in H1 to fund clinical development of lead CAR-T therapy
Operating costs fell yr/yr excluding share-based payments, reflecting manufacturing outsourcing savings
Outlook
Company prioritises dose escalation in adult trial and enrolment of first paediatric patients
Hemogenyx aims to complete technology transfer to Cellin and begin treating patients in Estonia
Result Drivers
SHARE-BASED PAYMENT CHARGE - Widened H1 loss was mainly attributed to a non-cash share-based payment expense from options granted
MANUFACTURING OUTSOURCING - Underlying operating costs fell after outsourcing HG-CT-1 manufacturing to Made Scientific
